INDEPENDENT · UNOFFICIAL FIELD GUIDE

Azeroth Survivors: the field guide that tells you what to actually do

Azeroth Survivors is a free, fan-made browser roguelike by Aethus. You pick a class and a zone, your spells fire automatically, and every level-up deals you three cards. Each run runs about 16 minutes, ends with a scheduled boss, and needs nothing more than a WebGPU-capable desktop browser — no account, no launcher, no WoW client.

This site is an independent, unofficial field guide. We don't host game files, mirrors, or modified executables. We explain how to start, how each class actually plays, what the meta looks like right now, and how to avoid the fake-site problem that has followed this game since launch.

Last updated: October 29, 2026

First 10 minutes

Load the game in Chrome or Edge. Wait for the full resource pull — first load is slow on purpose, the whole world is being cached locally. Click inside the canvas so keyboard input reaches the game. Read your class's starting ability, then start moving. Your job in the first three minutes is wave-clear, not damage. Take every area spell the draft offers: Blizzard, Volley, Consecration, Rain of Fire, Chain Lightning. Your first boss arrives around 2:15, and a single-target start without an area tool will not have the spawn curve under control by then.

Before you download

Before you download anything, read the safety page. The game's maintained entry point is Aethus's own site; the domain has passed Cloudflare scanning with no malicious finding, but fan mirrors and lookalike domains have been flagged for recent registration and third-party ad links. We explain exactly how to tell them apart.
